predict.question: You give yourself a budget of twelve taps. Opening a game app takes one tap plus two required unlock steps of one tap each. How many complete openings fit?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Indistractable discusses changing environments and access conditions around distractions.
modelBoundary: Direct access permits {A}; added steps {B}. Required access actions consume the fixed budget before another opening fits.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? People can spend more actions, bypass friction, or need the same access for useful work.
